event.title: chore: ensure safe config in the npmrc
event.body:
<!--
Thank you for your pull request. Please provide a description and 
note the Certificate of Origin below. 

-->

Adding latest NPM permission on .npmrc - enforcing:
- a wait time on update by default
- ignore all post install scripts
- block any git usage for packages

event.diff:
diff --git a/.npmrc b/.npmrc
index 43c97e719a5..bd684249468 100644
--- a/.npmrc
+++ b/.npmrc
@@ -1 +1,4 @@
 package-lock=false
+min-release-age=7
+ignore-scripts=true
+allow-git=none
